notes: Audit #3 Batch 2 (v1.11.74) — the LAST batch of the v1.11.72 full audit (93/100, 0 Critical, 0 High, 0 Medium); both approved batches are now built. (1) L25 — packaging guard for srv/: tools/make_release.py now fails loudly when an srv/*.py file is not in APP_FILES, mirroring the public/ check (the 1.11.64 srv/telegram.py omission class); verified live: a throwaway srv/ module makes make_release.py FAIL, removing it passes; test_release_packaging_covers_every_server_import + test_zip_without_telegram_rejected still pass. (2) L19 — chunked bodies in _read_json: Transfer-Encoding: chunked is now decoded (RFC 9112 §7.1 — BaseHTTPRequestHandler does not do it); a chunked POST without Content-Length now 200s instead of 400 «بدنه خالی», and a chunked body over the 10MB cap still 413s (cap enforced while accumulating); Content-Length path unchanged. (3) L24 — testbook restore outside the lock: _post_api_testbook now calls load_testbook() BEFORE taking STATE_LOCK (its cloud_restore_latest path is a network call); the comparison base and the 409 payload are re-read from the file INSIDE the lock, so a save landing in between is never clobbered; the L1 seq re-read and the M2 tombstone logic are intact. Verified live: corrupt testbook.json + stale save → 409 with the CURRENT seq (2, not 1); a slow-restore probe (~1s load_testbook in a tree copy) does NOT block a concurrent state save. (4) L2 — patch signal: a marker-less body that is near-complete (>= 80% of DEFAULT_STATE keys, i.e. >= 36/45) but falls below the 90% full threshold is still patched (behaviour unchanged), but the 200 response now carries additive "patched": true + "patched_kept" (the non-merged keys a full save would have deleted); the _full marker — not key counting — is the documented contract. Verified live: 40-key body with a deletion → 200 + "patched": true, flag kept; 41-key body → 200, flag cleared, no "patched" key. (5) P-103 — memoize hardestSubject/daySummary per render: RENDER_CACHE gains hardest (undefined = not computed; the computed value may itself be null) and daySummaries; programmeRuleViolations computes hardestSubject() once and passes it to dayIssues(iso, extraBox, excludeId, hard); outside renderAll the cache is null and both functions compute fresh as before. Measured on the same jsdom setup (mock date Sat 28 Nov, dashboard): hardestSubject calls per renderRulesCard/renderAll 56 → 1; programmeRuleViolations median 30.2ms → 19.3/18.6ms (two runs); renderRulesCard median 49.5ms → 78.9/35.6ms and renderAll 899.2ms → 1028.1/959.1ms across two runs — noisy on this 1.5-CPU VM (one 636ms outlier in run 1), no reliable regression signal; the rules-card output is byte-identical except the intended spacing change (below). (6) P-104 — compile derive_subject_topic patterns: the «تست آزمون» / class-subject / trailing-paren / grade-qualifier patterns and the clean_event_title + event_is_test subs are compiled once at module level in srv/google_sync.py (the class pattern lazily, from the cached SUBJECTS table). Measured: dry-run first-pull median 9.3ms → 5.7ms; cProfile of 5 pulls 0.138s → 0.071s total, derive_subject_topic 0.081s → 0.033s cumulative / 1775 calls (~59% → ~46% share); the merge result is identical (same links/boxes — the full sync test set passes, merge summary 318 boxes, 0 added/removed/updated/unlinked). LATENT (found, NOT fixed here): the shipped class pattern ends in a literal backspace byte (0x08), not a word boundary, so the «کلاس» branch never fires and derive falls through to the subject-in-title loop — the compiled pattern preserves that byte exactly (re hex escape) to keep the merge identical; turning it into a real boundary is a separate behaviour change (the seed's 56 class boxes carry the branch's topics). (7) P-105 — only ids in /api/calendar/unlinked: ?ids=1 returns {id} entries (+ suggested_event_uid/title/date/start/end only where a suggestion exists — the picker renders the suggestion's slot); refreshUnlinked() fetches ?ids=1; the default keeps full objects. Measured live: 65,372 bytes → 5,170 bytes (−92%), same 318 boxes, same events/tombstones; the reconnect-picker round-trip still works in jsdom. (8) U-301 — the 2.5s next-focus fade in renderToday is removed: the highlight now persists until the next tick moves it or a tab change clears the pointer (each render re-applies it); the guarded auto-scroll still fires once per tick; the deliberately brief 2.5s highlight in goFirstRemainingAssignment (Assignments primary) is untouched. Verified live: tick b030 → highlight on b031; 3s idle with no render → still on b031; next tick moves it; tab change clears it. (9) U-302 — the assignments zero-result branch now renders the shared emptyStateHtml (title = noAssignments) with the clear-filter action (asgFilterClear) whenever a filter is what emptied the list; the action clears the search/subject/status filters AND the topic filter. Verified live: searching zzzqqq999 → one .empty-state with the clear-filter button; clicking it restores the list. (10) U-303 — page-primary in the testbook list view: the «ثبت سؤال غلط» button is marked page-primary only when no book is open (list view); in the drill-down the marker is dropped, where «+ افزودن فصل جدید» is the one primary. Verified live: list view page-primary = 1, drill-down = 1, the other 9 tabs exactly 1 each. (11) P-1172-01 — own interval for the exam-night reminder: checkExamNightReminder() now runs on its own 60s setInterval (in addition to the gated timer-tick call) with the L17 hidden-tab guard; the one-shot flag (nightReminderShown === TODAY, set before the toast) prevents double-fire when both callers run. Verified live: boot 2026-12-03T22:00:30, toggle ON, NO running timer → toast fires once; a second call does not double-fire; with a running timer it still fires once. (12) P-1172-02 — spacing check to programme end: renderRulesCard now runs the spacing check from the week start to progEnd (was ws+13); the exam-day excusals are unchanged. Verified live on 28 Nov: the card now shows 3 gaps — geometry 2026-12-06 ← 2026-12-12 (6d), discrete 2026-12-02 ← 2026-12-08 (6d), discrete 2026-12-09 ← 2026-12-16 (7d) — and the two exam-excused gaps (geometry 1←5 Dec, physics 3←6 Dec) stay unflagged; the violations list (39) is byte-identical. (13) P-1172-03 — clean error for a missing /data.json seed: a fresh release-zip install (data.json deliberately excluded) now answers 200 {"meta": {}, "boxes": []} instead of a 500 with a raw errno + absolute path; any other read failure answers a clean Persian message (the detail is logged server-side only). Verified live on an extracted release zip: GET /data.json clean, /api/boxes still 200 with count 0. (14) Q-211 — duplication extraction: analytics daily aggregation → anAggregateSeries(list, keyFn); B2 handler preamble → _require_b2_config(); timer session traversal → distributeUsefulOverSessions(boxId, remaining); error-log aggregation → testTrendFromLog(entries) + trendLabelFromSeries(s); recall-grade buttons → srGradeRow(onGrade); backup-restore success tails → bkRestoreSuccess(); state-save note → the existing _box_api_note renamed _note_app_edits_safe (3 box-API callers + the 2 state-handler sites); calendar import preview/import → _post_api_calendar_import_body(tag, apply); backup prune loop → _prune_versions(versions, delete=); the two JSON-decode blocks in _read_json (chunked + Content-Length) → _parse_json_body(raw). The two parallel save paths stay separate (old R5); the conflict-restore tail keeps its own renderBackup (it runs unconditionally). Duplication count (same 6-line-block method as the audit): 33 groups / 66 occurrences → 9 groups / 18 occurrences (Python 9/18 → 3/6, JS 24/48 → 6/12); the 9 left are trivial/coincidental windows (an error-string append, ts = now_ts(), chart geometry, bulk-apply loops) with no safe extraction. (15) C1/C2/C5/C6 — dead CSS + comments: the dead .day-card/.day-head rules are deleted (5 base rules + the media-query line; .day-tick/.day-tick-row stay — they are live); Handler.send_error is overridden so GET /api/* 404s return {"error": "not found"} JSON (non-/api/* 404s keep HTML; other codes untouched); the M-UI5 comment now says only the muted pair breaks (4.45:1) — accent-text on accent-soft at 4.57:1 PASSES AA; the raw-accent-on-white comments now say ~2.5:1 (2.48:1, was 2.3:1) at both spots. (16) U-304 — re-measured only, no code change: renderAll() on a quiet machine (no other servers, fresh-seeded data dir, 2 runs × 10 samples) is median 959–1028ms, max 1355ms — inside the previous audit's 780–1373ms range and well below the flagged 1.5–2.6s, so the finding is NOT reproduced and is closed as contention. Nothing deferred except the P-104 class-pattern boundary (latent, see (6)). i18n 1441/1441 (no new keys — U-302 reuses noAssignments + asgFilterClear). This is the LAST batch of audit #3.
